import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = 65;
    static final long mod = 1000000007L;

    static class Matrix {
        int h, w;
        long[] a;

        Matrix(int n) {
            this.h = n;
            this.w = n;
            this.a = new long[n * n];
        }

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.h = n;
            this.w = m;
            this.a = new long[n * m];
        }

        Matrix(int n, int m, long[] a_) {
            this.h = n;
            this.w = m;
            this.a = a_;
        }

        long get(int r, int c) {
            return a[r * w + c];
        }

        void set(int r, int c, long val) {
            a[r * w + c] = val;
        }

        Matrix plusEquals(Matrix m) {
            if (this.h != m.h || this.w != m.w) throw new AssertionError();
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                a[i] += m.a[i];
                a[i] %= mod;
            }
            return this;
        }

        Matrix minusEquals(Matrix m) {
            if (this.h != m.h || this.w != m.w) throw new AssertionError();
            for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                a[i] -= m.a[i];
                a[i] = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            }
            return this;
        }

        Matrix multiplyEquals(Matrix m) {
            if (w != m.h) throw new AssertionError();
            Matrix ret = new Matrix(h, m.w);
            for (int i = 0; i < h; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m.w; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < w; k++) {
                        sum += get(i, k) * m.get(k, j);
                        sum %= mod;
                    }
                    ret.set(i, j, sum);
                }
            }
            this.h = ret.h;
            this.w = ret.w;
            this.a = ret.a;
            return this;
        }

        Matrix plus(Matrix m) {
            return new Matrix(this.h, this.w, this.a.clone()).plusEquals(m);
        }

        Matrix minus(Matrix m) {
            return new Matrix(this.h, this.w, this.a.clone()).minusEquals(m);
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix m) {
            return new Matrix(this.h, this.w, this.a.clone()).multiplyEquals(m);
        }
    }

    static <T> Matrix unit(int n) {
        Matrix ret = new Matrix(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret.set(i, i, 1);
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static <T> Matrix matpow(Matrix a, int n) {
        if (a.h != a.w) throw new AssertionError();
        Matrix ret = unit(a.h);
        while (n > 0) {
            if ((n & 1) == 1) ret = ret.multiply(a);
            a = a.multiply(a);
            n >>= 1;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    static Matrix[] a = new Matrix[MAX_SIZE];

    static Matrix calc(int i, int k) {
        return matpow(a[i + k], k - i).multiply(matpow(a[i], i));
    }

    static long solve(long n, long k) {
        long cnt = 0;
        long tmp = n;
        while (tmp > 0) {
            tmp /= k;
            cnt++;
        }
        int size = (int) (cnt + 5);
        Matrix[] b = new Matrix[size];
        Matrix[] c = new Matrix[size];
        Matrix[] d = new Matrix[(int) (k + 1)];

        b[0] = a[k - 1];
        c[0] = matpow(b[0], k - 1);
        b[1] = calc(k - 1, (int) k);
        c[1] = matpow(b[1], (int) k);
        Matrix s = unit((int) (2 * k + 1));
        for (int j = 2; j < cnt + 2; j++) {
            b[j] = calc((int) (k - j % k), (int) k);
            s = s.multiply(c[j - 1]);
            b[j] = b[j].multiply(s);
            c[j] = matpow(b[j], (int) (k - 1));
        }

        int idx = 1;
        int rem = (int) (n % k);
        n -= rem;
        int q = 0;
        tmp = n;
        if (tmp > 0) {
            while (tmp % k == 0) {
                q++;
                tmp /= k;
            }
        }
        q = (int) ((k - q % k) % k);
        Matrix ans = unit((int) (2 * k + 1));
        ans = matpow(a[q], rem).multiply(matpow(a[q + (int) k], Math.max(rem - q, 0)));

        long nDivK = n / k;
        if (nDivK == 0) {
            return (ans.get(2 * (int) k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % mod;
        }
        nDivK--;
        long N = nDivK;
        while (N > 0) {
            long t = N % k;
            if (t != 0) {
                ans = ans.multiply(matpow(b[idx], (int) t));
            }
            N /= k;
            idx++;
        }
        ans = ans.multiply(b[1]);
        return (ans.get(2 * (int) k, 0) + ans.get(0, 0)) % mod;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long k = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (int) k + 1; i++) {
            a[i] = new Matrix(2 * (int) k + 1);
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                a[i].set(0, j, 1);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < 2 * (int) k - 1; j++) {
                a[i].set(j + 1, j, 1);
            }
            a[i].set(2 * (int) k, 0, 1);
            a[i].set(2 * (int) k, 2 * (int) k, 1);
        }

        System.out.println(solve(n, k));
        sc.close();
    }
}
